title: Rail of light
description: Steps on a straight rail of light: the rail draws across the frame behind a comet (down the side on a phone), each node blooms when the light reaches it and a stem lights down into the step's card, whose number, title and line rise. Two or three steps are set large and fill the frame; four to six share one baseline. The comet keeps travelling while the slide is on screen. Times like 06:00 as titles read as a timeline.

props.steps: required, 2-6 of {title, text}: a short title (or a time) and one line
